$comment: Source of truth for scheduled jobs. Re-read on every ticks() — edits apply live. Schedule is 5-field cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Runs land in jobs/runs/<job_id>/<run_id>.md.

jobs.description: Send me the order report at 11pm

action.prompt: Compile today's orders into a summary report and send it to the user.

jobs.description: Keep memory/memory.md inside its token budget: move cold facts to memory/archive/ (one fact per file, update archive/index.md), keep hot facts inline

action.prompt: Review memory/memory.md against its 6000-token budget (ADR-0001). If over or near budget, move the coldest facts to memory/archive/ as one-fact-per-file entries, update memory/archive/index.md, and keep the hottest facts inline. Apply the write policies: dedupe, update over duplicate, delete falsified.

jobs.description: Roll old entries from sessions/past_sessions.md into sessions/archive/YYYY-MM.md, keeping the newest entries within budget

action.prompt: Check sessions/past_sessions.md against its 4000-token budget. Move entries that no longer fit into sessions/archive/<YYYY-MM>.md grouped by month, newest first, preserving every entry verbatim.

jobs.description: Regenerate tools/descriptions.md and skills/descriptions.md from the packs (enable when Phase 2/3 generators land)

action.prompt: Regenerate tools/descriptions.md from tools/*/*/manifest.yaml and skills/descriptions.md from skills/*/*/SKILL.md, preserving the table format defined in each file.

jobs.description: Weekly offline eval run; record baseline drift (enable when the Phase 5 harness lands)

action.prompt: Run the offline eval suite in tests/evals, compare scores against the recorded baseline, and summarize any regressions.
